note: The two sets are identical except for a single claim: Set A adds the condition "S-301" to the 3/8" through-bolt claim, which is supported by the C1 S-301 and A4 S-301 detail callouts shown on the page, so it is not an error but also not a decisive improvement. Both sets read the dimension strings correctly (10'-3 3/4", 12'-3 3/4", 7'-0", 3'-6", 7 1/16", 4 13/16", 1 1/2", 5/8", 3/8" THROUGH BOLT, L3X3X1/4) and both bind them to vague placeholder entities such as "right-side component", "C1 S-301 component" and "dimension". Both also repeat 7'-0" and 12'-3 3/4" under two names and include a garbled entity "MEMBER - NORTH/SOUTH". With the same strengths and the same weaknesses, the sets are effectively equivalent.
remarks: Both extractions use generic placeholder entities ("right-side component", "C1 S-301 component", "dimension", "structural member") instead of naming the actual members (angles L3X3X1/4, PV structural member, base/plate details), so most claims are only weakly bound even though the quoted values are read correctly. The entity "MEMBER - NORTH/SOUTH" is a truncation of the garbled text-layer title "DULE A/B - PV STRUCTURAL MEMBER - NORTH/SOUTH". 7'-0" and 12'-3 3/4" are each stated twice (once under a module title, once as a bare "dimension"), and several bare dimension claims (3"-8 3/8", 3'-1 5/16", 2'-2 7/8", 6 3/16", 1'-8 11/16", 2'-5 5/16", 1'-11 1/8", 4 3/4", 6 13/16", 2'-3 7/8") present on the page are not claimed by either set. The text layer is badly fragmented (title lines cut to "DULE B/A"), so entity naming relies on the image.
